remarks: Location, Location, Location. Lovely updated 2 BR apartment in East Norwalk's water community. Walk to water. Located on the 1st floor of a 2 family home offering plenty of natural light, 2 spacious bedrooms, Large Living Room, Kitchen w/granite countertops and plenty of cabinets, pantry and office/desk area, recessed lighting, Full Bath & Washer/Dryer in apartment. Beautiful hardwood flooring & recessed lighting throughout. Clean & efficient gas heat and central air. Patio to enjoy relaxing evenings and 1 off-street reserved parking space. Walk/bike to all 06855 amenities. Train Station, Shops, restaurants, Farm to table market, liquor store, BJ Ryans East, Upper Crust Bagels, Mr. Frosty's Ice cream, Harbor Lights waterfront restaurant, hair salon, beaches & train station(s). A short walk/ride to SoNo's nightlife, restaurants, Maritime Aquarium & Museum and the SoNo Collection Mall. References, credit & background check required. Good credit a MUST. 2 Months Security. Come and enjoy the lifestyle of 06855. A commuter's delight located just 55 minutes from Manhattan and 5 minutes to the East or South Norwalk train stations, I-95 and the Merritt Pwy.
